name: wet-mcp
description: Open-source MCP server for AI agents: web search, content extraction, and library docs.

EMBEDDING_MODELS.title: Embedding model chain (optional)
EMBEDDING_MODELS.description: CSV 'provider/model,provider/model' (order = litellm fallback); provider inferred from prefix. Empty = local ONNX through fastretrieval. Managed route: cohere/embed-v4.0 via EMBEDDING_API_BASE; paid provider use needs an approved cap.

RERANK_MODELS.title: Rerank model chain (optional)
RERANK_MODELS.description: CSV 'provider/model,...'; provider inferred from prefix. Empty = local ONNX cross-encoder. Managed route: cohere/rerank-v4.0-fast via RERANK_API_BASE; paid provider use needs an approved cap.

LLM_MODELS.title: LLM model chain (optional)
LLM_MODELS.description: CSV 'provider/model,...'; provider inferred from prefix. Empty = LLM features off. Managed completion: openrouter/minimax/minimax-m3:free only, with no paid fallback.

EMBEDDING_API_BASE.title: Embedding endpoint (optional)
EMBEDDING_API_BASE.description: Custom endpoint or CF AI Gateway. Cohere: <gateway>/cohere/v2/embed.

RERANK_API_BASE.title: Rerank endpoint (optional)
RERANK_API_BASE.description: Custom endpoint or CF AI Gateway. Cohere: <gateway>/cohere; the client appends /v1/rerank.

LLM_API_BASE.title: Completion endpoint (optional)
LLM_API_BASE.description: Custom endpoint or CF AI Gateway for the selected completion model.

JINA_AI_API_KEY.title: Jina AI API key (optional)
JINA_AI_API_KEY.description: Enables jina_ai/ models referenced in a model chain. Without any cloud key the server uses local ONNX. https://jina.ai/api-dashboard/

GEMINI_API_KEY.title: Gemini API key (optional)
GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Enables gemini/ models referenced in a model chain. https://ai.google.dev/

OPENAI_API_KEY.title: OpenAI API key (optional)
OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Enables openai/ models referenced in a model chain. https://platform.openai.com/api-keys

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.title: OpenRouter API key (optional)
OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Enables openrouter/ models in the selected chain. https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys

COHERE_API_KEY.title: Cohere API key (optional)
COHERE_API_KEY.description: Enables cohere/ models referenced in a model chain. https://dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys

GITHUB_TOKEN.title: GitHub personal access token (optional)
GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional. Bumps GitHub API rate limit (60->5000 req/hr) for library docs discovery. https://github.com/settings/tokens
